hints.title: Connected Components Partition
hints.text: Cells that are not blocked (-1) can reach all other cells within their 4-directionally connected component.

hints.title: Component Remoteness Sum
hints.text: For any cell in a connected component of sum C_sum, its remoteness equals Total_sum - C_sum.

hints.title: Aggregating Over Cells
hints.text: Summing across all C_count cells in that component contributes exactly C_count * (Total_sum - C_sum) to the final answer.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Breadth-first search traversing each grid cell once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Calculating path reachability for each cell independently takes O(n^4).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n^2) auxiliary memory for visited matrix.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decompose into connected components and aggregate algebraic contribution per component.
